excluded_aws.parent_decision: Do not acquire or install boto3/botocore/s3transfer; removed only their three base lock blocks. No AWS/CI source edits.
notes: No active AWS imports were found in the five installed local setup packages or audited local Editor/test tooling. The search covered Python sources in Tools, scripts, Gems, AutomatedTesting and python.
s3transfer has no direct repository import in that scope; it is a boto3 transitive dependency.

scripts/build/TestImpactAnalysis/persistent_storage/__init__.py eagerly imports PersistentStorageS3. Local TIA imports can therefore fail without boto3 even when no S3 bucket is selected; CI/TIA remain excluded and unverified.
AutomatedTesting/Gem/PythonTests/automatedtesting_shared/screenshot_utils.py mentions an unresolved boto3/s3_utils dependency in a comment, not an active AWS import.

installation_semantics.requirements: cmake/LYPython.cmake:162 installs the lock with pip install -r. Despite its preceding comment, this command does not pass --no-deps; active dependency closure must therefore be complete.
installation_semantics.local_packages: cmake/LYPython.cmake:300 uses local editable installs with --no-deps. INSTALLED_ENGINE may use local source/archive fallback. No setup_requires or pyproject/setup.cfg were found in the five local setup package roots.
installation_semantics.pip_check: Current LYPython pip check failure is a warning, not a fatal gate; acceptance must explicitly require its success.
installation_semantics.closure: Metadata-level closure for Windows CPython 3.10 with no extras is covered by retained 43 exact base pins. Markers active for pytest: exceptiongroup/tomli (Python<3.11) and colorama (win32). Inactive extras are not provisioned.

bundled_tools.source: CPython 3.10.13 ensurepip bundled wheels; no upgrades proposed.

installation_semantics.offline_proposal: After audited manual acquisition and receipt/hash verification, use the local Release CPython 3.10.13 virtual environment with PIP_NO_INDEX=1, PIP_CONFIG_FILE=NUL, PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 and only absolute local find-links. Install the separately pinned wheel build tool with its own hashed requirement, then install original base requirements with --require-hashes --no-build-isolation --no-cache-dir. Atomicwrites is built from its original hashed local sdist. No PEP517 automatic build dependency acquisition. Local repo packages use --no-deps. DCC is separately opt-in; Unipath likewise uses original local hashed sdist.
installation_semantics.derived_wheels: Locally built wheels are new artifacts with new genuine hashes. Do not claim their hashes match original sdist locks; record provenance and hash separately before preferring a derived wheel.
installation_semantics.not_a_minimum_proof: 43 pins are a conservative retained base after excluding the three AWS pins, not a demonstrated mathematically minimal set of Editor imports.

legal_and_validation_limits: License fields/classifiers are metadata-level evidence, not complete redistributable payload review. Preserve each wheel's license/NOTICE/license-file records before redistribution.
NumPy/SciPy/Pillow wheels bundle native components whose individual licenses/notices require inspection after approved acquisition; JSON project license alone is insufficient.
Docutils reports public domain, PSF, BSD-2 and GPL-3 material. Inspect COPYING.txt and per-file scope; do not simplify it to BSD or decide legal acceptance here.
Certifi uses MPL-2.0; retain LICENSE. Packaging/python-dateutil dual license notices and O3DE local package Apache-2.0 OR MIT notices remain required.
requests 2.32.0 is yanked: 'Yanked due to conflicts with CVE-2024-35195 mitigation'. Exact original pin/hash retained by scope; no version bump or acceptance decision made.
Atomicwrites/Unipath source setup scripts were reviewed at official GitHub tags/commit; the actual acquired sdists still require member/path and setup/license audit before execution.
Wheel tags/Requires-Python support the Release CPython3.10 Windowsx64 selection; imports/ABI behavior, native wheels, Debug interpreter, offline install and pip check remain unexecuted.
Imageio and other tools can perform optional media/plugin/network operations at runtime; dependency acquisition closure does not prove every tool runtime is network-free.
This evidence does not establish full engine configure/build, product/runtime acceptance, complete SBOM or transitive filesystem/network isolation.
